summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, detects the installer's platform/architecture (including Alpine/musl), downloads the Bun runtime zip from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the Bun binary, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` on a tarball-bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line bundle using string-array rotation obfuscation (a shift/push decoder over a large mixed numeric+string constant array, plus a custom base64-like alphabet decoder), not human-readable, not referenced by the advertised Vue renderer API in `dist/v2/Browser.js`, and reachable only via the preinstall dropper. Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle at install time yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's host under a runtime outside Node-scoped tooling, and has no connection to the package's stated Vue renderer purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
